values.note: Reservable online 24/7 at parkreservations.maryland.gov up to 365 days ahead and for the same day ('Reservations can be made for today'), or at 1-888-432-2267 (Mon-Fri 9-5). Two-night minimum Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day; holiday weekends three nights. The 14-night limit is cumulative: 14 nights in any 21 days across Maryland state park campgrounds, then seven nights away.

booking.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/southern/Cedarville/Camping.aspx ('Reservations can be made by calling 1-888-432-2267, 9 a.m. - 5 p.m. Monday through Friday. Online reservations can be made at parkreservations.maryland.gov, 24 hours a day/ 7 days a week.'; 'From Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day there is a two-night minimum stay. Holiday weekends require a three-night minimum stay.'; 'Campers are limited to 14 cumulative nights of camping in Maryland State Park campgrounds during any 21-day period.') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/cedarville-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380104 (Booking Window, Campsite Electric/Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/cedarville-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380104 (per-site details: all 10 'Campsite Electric' sites, Hickory Loop, 'Electrical Service (amp): 30') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/southern/Cedarville/Camping.aspx ('Campsites on the inner loop are equipped with electric, and sites on the outer loop are primitive.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 38 family sites on the booking site: Hickory Loop's 10 electric sites (inner loop, 22-30 ft) and 14 primitive outer-loop sites (15-30 ft), and Ironwood Loop's 14 primitive sites (25-30 ft, five pull-throughs; sites 38-41 are for campers with horses). Two youth group loops besides. The booking site lists Ironwood Loop as closed for 2027 and unreservable June 27 - October 2, 2026.

sites.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/cedarville-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380104 (site list and per-site details: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry; Reservable Dates: 'Ironwood Loop Campsites 28-37: April 3, 2026-June 27, 2026, October 2, 2026-October 31, 2026'; 2027: 'Ironwood Loop Campsites 28-37: Closed') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/southern/Cedarville/Camping.aspx ('A horse is required to stay on sites 38-41.'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/southern/Cedarville/Camping.aspx ('The bathhouse is located within the center of the loop and blue water spigots are located throughout the loop.') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/cedarville-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380104 (Services and Amenities Within Park: 'Dump Station', 'Restrooms', 'Showers'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed fees ($18.50 / $24.50 electric, oc.aspx), reservable on parkreservations.maryland.gov 365 days ahead incl. same day, and the inherited weekend (Memorial Day - Labor Day) and 3-night holiday minimums, now on the entry with the 14-in-21-night limit. Added 30-amp electric (10 sites), 38 family sites to 30 ft with pull-throughs, showers, water spigots, dump. Not stated: whether walk-ups are taken (fcfs left inherited), water/sewer at sites, a non-resident camping charge (none shown on oc.aspx).
flags: Season (manual, not overwritten): the entry holds 2025's April 4 - October 26 with 'no 2026 dates posted', but the booking site now shows 2026 dates: 'Status: Open through Sun Oct 25 2026' and 'Hickory Loop Campsites: April 3, 2026-October 31, 2026' (2027: April 2 - October 30). DNR's camping page says 'open from April to October'. Consider updating the season note.

Fees (not overwritten): the booking site's Facility Rates table lists 'Campsite Non-Electric $19.50-$25.00 / Campsite Electric $25.50-$26.50' for the 2026 (Apr 03 - Oct 25) and 2027 peak seasons, $1 above DNR's $18.50/$24.50 base, with the footnote 'Displayed rates are base rates and do not reflect discounts, surcharges (holiday/weekend/residency)'. The fee note's 'no out-of-state camping surcharge' is not confirmed: Elk Neck's DNR page states non-Maryland residents pay $1 more a night, and the booking footnote names residency surcharges.
Phone: entry has none; DNR gives 'Contact: Park Headquarters 301-888-1410' (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/southern/cedarville.aspx).
Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's camping page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/southern/Cedarville/Camping.aspx.
